title: service lint config + extractor-lint CI job
objective: Create services/repo-truth-extractor/ruff.toml with lenient baseline and add extractor-lint CI job. Zero lint jobs existed despite strict mypy profile in root pyproject.

changes_made.change: Created new lenient ruff configuration (457 baseline violations reduced to 0 via rule disabling)
changes_made.rationale: Establishes lint baseline without requiring source reformatting. 11 rule families disabled with per-rule rationales (E402, F401, F841, E701, E401, E722, F811, E702, E741, F541, F821, I001). Future waves (R1+) can ratchet strictness.

changes_made.change: Added extractor-lint job with ruff check invocation (after extractor-full, before auditor-router)
changes_made.rationale: Provides CI-level enforcement of lint baseline. Non-blocking (advisory) per spec; can be elevated to blocking in future PRs.

changes_made.change: Updated ci-summary needs array and gate logic to include extractor-lint (4 locations)
changes_made.rationale: Ensures lint results flow into PR gate summary and can optionally be promoted to blocking check

execution_summary.scope: Configuration and CI workflow only; no source code changes

validations.name: ruff check passes with new config
validations.command: mise exec -- python3 -m ruff check services/repo-truth-extractor 2>&1 | tail -1
validations.evidence: Zero violations on current code with lenient baseline

validations.name: extractor-lint job present in CI
validations.evidence: New CI job is wired into workflow

validations.name: CI YAML is valid
validations.command: mise exec -- python3 -c "import yaml; yaml.safe_load(open('.github/workflows/ci-complete.yml')); print('✅ valid')"

rules_disabled.E: pycodestyle (indentation, whitespace, line-too-long, etc.) - 289 violations - requires reformatting
rules_disabled.F: pyflakes (unused imports, undefined names, etc.) - 162 violations - requires removals/audits
rules_disabled.I: isort import sorting - 62 violations - requires import reordering

notes: Lenient baseline achieves green with zero violations via rule disabling instead of source reformatting, per R0 charter. 457 baseline violations + 62 import-order violations reduced to 0 via configuration. Ready for future strictness increases (R1 can enable subsets of E/F/I/D rules once source is refactored). CI job is non-blocking; can be elevated to blocking check via branch protection update.
